name: tracker-spoke-lifecycle
goal: Drive durable Tracker push and pull from one abortable spoke-side lifecycle, including lost-receipt retries, identity replay and shutdown.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Preserve one active lifecycle per link, immediate work on operation commit, retry without data loss, signed receipt replay after hub identity reset, and cleanup before the caller closes SQLite. Use the shared store and an injected abortable transport.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: One generation per link drives pull backoff, immediate push on journal changes, periodic receipt retry, and identity replay. Abort cancels requests and timers and joins both workers before shutdown.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Unchanged fixture rejects overlapping owners and observed two push attempts with one unique op after a dropped reply, plus cancellation of the outstanding pull. Local red at 8682c7b4fd and green with the implementation.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
